steps.stepDescription: Open a web browser and navigate to https://kargone-admin.appening.xyz/dealer.
Click the first button from the left side in the navbar's right corner.
Select the 'Lead Management' option in the sidebar by clicking the second menu item.
Click the edit icon adjacent to the zipcode field to enable editing.
Clear the existing value in the zipcode field and enter '33320'.
Click the tick mark beside the zipcode field to save the updated value.
Scroll to the bottom of the page and click the 'Save Changes' button to update the form.
Take a screenshot of the completed task for verification.
